_meta.source: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) IS 1893 (Part 1): 2016 Criteria for Earthquake Resistant Design of Structures - Annex E Seismic Zones of Important Towns and Seismic Zone Map
_meta.coverage_scope_note: Version 1.0.0 provides broad state/UT baseline seismic zones with specific city and district overrides for major urban clusters and demo-relevant centers (Bengaluru, Guwahati, Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Chennai, Kolkata, Srinagar, Bhuj, Patna, Pune, Ahmedabad, etc.). Complete 700+ district-level enumeration is planned for version 1.1.0.
